versions.content: BSW inter-partition client-server communication Type: valid Description: The BSWMDT shall provide means to specify required and provided procedure calls for inter-partition and/or inter-core communication within BSW. These shall support both synchronous and asynchronous client-server pattern and shall allow the corresponding BSW Scheduler API to be generated. Rationale: Optimize load balancing between the cores w.r.t. BSW services. Increase efficiency of BSW service execution. Enable optimization of multi core SW distribution. Dependencies: – Use Case: Parallel execution of applications on a multi-core system. Supporting Material: –
